title: A homotopy-type-theoretic generalization of neurosymbolic inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.17851v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A wide range of neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems compute one functional: a belief-weighted sum of a logical quantity over a space of $\sigma$-structures, of which weighted model counting, fuzzy logic, and probabilistic logic are special cases. This account is built on sets, and a set deliberately forgets two things that are important for NeSy: when two $\sigma$-structures are the same up to a symmetry of the theory, and how many distinct proofs witness a query. Types, in the sense of homotopy type theory, preserve this information and turn the functional into a belief-weighted homotopy cardinality, a notion of size that counts each object in inverse proportion to its symmetries. We develop the framework from scratch for NeSy systems, prove a conservativity theorem that recovers the classical functional when symmetries are trivial, and show that the symmetry our framework exposes is exactly the one behind reasoning shortcuts. translated_title: 神经符号推理的同伦类型论推广
translated_abstract: 大量神经符号系统计算同一个泛函：在σ-结构空间上对某个逻辑量进行信念加权求和，加权模型计数、模糊逻辑和概率逻辑都是其特例。这一解释建立在集合之上，而集合有意遗忘了两件对神经符号系统重要的事情：两个σ-结构在理论的对称性下何时相同，以及有多少个不同的证明可以见证一个查询。同伦类型论意义上的类型保留了这些信息，并将该泛函转化为信念加权的同伦基数——一种按每个对象的对称性倒数比例对其进行计数的大小概念。我们从零开始为神经符号系统构建了这一框架，证明了一个保守性定理：当对称性平凡时，该框架恢复经典的泛函；并且表明我们的框架所揭示的对称性，正是推理捷径背后的那个对称性。
tldr: 该论文用同伦类型论将神经符号推理的经典信念加权求和泛函推广为信念加权同伦基数，保留了集合框架所忽略的对称性与证明数信息，证明其在平凡对称性下退化为经典泛函，并揭示该对称性正是推理捷径的根源。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes neurosymbolic inference by recasting the classical belief-weighted sum functional as a belief-weighted homotopy cardinality via homotopy type theory, preserving symmetry and proof-count information that sets discard, recovering the classical functional under trivial symmetries, and showing that the exposed symmetry underlies reasoning shortcuts.
